summary_en: 1,000 ordinary shares of subsidiary Kamogawa Co., Ltd. to be acquired at ¥1,018,000 total (¥1,018/share, TSE closing price 2026-07-17). 0.015% of shares outstanding. Relative transaction. Scheduled 2026-07-17.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares held by subsidiary (acquisition from subsidiary based on Companies Act Article 163)
translation_en_brief: Cominix Co., Ltd. resolved on 2026-07-17 to acquire 1,000 ordinary shares held by its subsidiary Kamogawa Co., Ltd. pursuant to Companies Act Article 163. The acquisition price is ¥1,018,000 total (¥1,018 per share, equivalent to the TSE closing price on 2026-07-17). This represents 0.015% of shares outstanding (calculated against the ex-treasury base of 6,868,482 shares). The method is relative transaction. Acquisition is scheduled for 2026-07-17. Kamogawa Co., Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary engaged in industrial material wholesale, private-label, and renovation business, with head office in Kyoto.
